verdict.rationale: Bugbot's own docs state that the Teams plan includes "analytics and reporting," so an org-level reporting capability exists. Nothing describes what those analytics show. The 80% resolution-rate figure is a vendor blog benchmark, not a user-facing dashboard metric. Missing for 10: documented dashboards of findings, acceptance/resolution-rate metrics per org, review-coverage reporting across repos, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I see dashboards of findings, acceptance rates, and review coverage across my org

citations.quote: Bugbot Teams includes code reviews on all PRs, analytics and reporting, effort level controls, and advanced rules and settings.
